settings.name_in_paper: Dynamic pricing with adversarial inventory constraint (censored linear noisy demand)
unmapped: Action is a price p_t in [0, p_max]; potential demand d_t = a - b p_t + N_t is linear with unknown a, b
Observed demand is censored by an adversarially pre-committed inventory level gamma_t revealed at start of round: D_t = min(gamma_t, d_t); reward p_t D_t
Noise N_t i.i.d., zero mean, supported on [-c, c], unknown distribution with L_F-Lipschitz CDF
Learner knows bounds a_max, b_min, b_max, gamma_min, c, p_max
Regret against per-round optimal price p_t^* given gamma_t
Inequality assumptions on parameters (Assumption 4) and T larger than any polynomial of problem constants (Assumption 5)
settings.definition_quote: At each time $t=1,2,\ldots, T$, we firstly propose a price $p_t$, and then a price-dependent \emph{potential demand} occurs as $d_t$. However, we might have no access to $d_t$ as it is censored by an \emph{adversarial} inventory level $\gamma_t$. Instead, we observe a censored demand $D_t = \min\{\gamma_t, d_t\}$ and receive the revenue $r_t$ as a reward at $t$.

conditions: Linear demand d_t = a - b p + N_t (Assumption 1)
Known bounds a<=a_max, b_min<=b<=b_max, gamma_t>=gamma_min, N_t in [-c,c], p_t in [0,p_max] (Assumption 2)
Noise i.i.d. zero mean with L_F-Lipschitz CDF (Assumption 3)
Parameter inequalities of Assumption 4 (e.g. a-c>gamma_t>2c, gamma_min > a_max - b_min p_max + c, p_max >= a/(2b))
T larger than any polynomial of problem constants (Assumption 5)

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Let $\tau={\sqrt{T}}$ in \Cref{algo:C20CB}. For any adversarial $\{\gamma_t\}_{t=1}^T$ input sequence, C20CB suffers at most $\tilde{O}\left(\sqrt{T}\cdot\log\frac{T}{\delta}\right)$ regret, with probability $\Pr\geq 1-\delta$.

results.notes: Regret defined via expected revenue functions r_t(p) against per-round optimal prices. Mapping to ontology is approximate: pricing with censored demand, continuous 1-D action, inventory treated as adversarial context. Algorithm runs ~O~(T^{5/4}) total time.
